headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: PIA (9)

summary: Charles Leclerc won the British Grand Prix from P2 on the grid, 0.4s ahead of George Russell, with Lewis Hamilton completing the podium.
Franco Colapinto made the biggest climb, from P19 to P9.
Kimi Antonelli had a day to forget, dropping from P1 to P15.
The race was neutralised by 2 safety cars and 2 virtual safety cars.
There were 51 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 25 points over George Russell.
